title: Brendan Sorsby Next Team Odds: NFL Announces No Supplemental Draft, QB Force to Wait Until 2027

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brendan Sorsby Next Team Odds: NFL Announces No Supplemental Draft, QB Force to Wait Until 2027
sources.description: The NFL announced on Tuesday that it would not be holding a Supplemental Draft in 2026 as originally planned, meaning Brendan Sorsby has no avenue into the NFL until 2027.
